title: Halls where he played: Celestan, Piku, St. Teresa Hall and others
summary: He played banquets at a hall with George Astute and Joe Nicholas, worked once with Celestan at St. Teresa Hall, and gave his own dance with Rena.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Did you ever hear any music over, there's a new hall up there on Durbanese Street?
Well I played there a couple of times with George Astute, I played a couple of Bonquets there with George Astute and Joe Nicklaus and that bass player, what's his name again?
I played a couple of times with a couple of times with a drum. I played a drum. I played a drum.

And Dave, Dave, what do you mean? Dave, that's all I know used to play. And Chani, used to play with Chani. I had a job at the last roundup, used to play with Chani and Po Re. I played so many different places at the last roundup, yeah, we used to play there, me and Chani and he's living here, Chani. Yes. I never did get to meet him. I saw him on the street once, about a half a block away somebody pointed him out but I
never did get to talk to him. He used to play with the tuxedo. Yes, Celestan and that group I think. Celestan.

Did you ever work with Celestan at any time? I don't see now. I think, yeah, I worked with Celestan one time, on Liberty at the St. Teresa Hall. Oh yeah. They had a hall build build in the yard. I worked with them there when their first created, when their first first opened. between Jackson and Phillip. I think they ought to be there now. I know they're still down.
Yeah, I remember one big hall. There's a church, one place, used to call it an old Providence Hall, I believe, too, way up there.
Yeah, and then they had the San Suu that was running at that time. We used to play up there, too. I played there at the time, at the San Suu on Howard Street.
I was going to ask about the artesian hall. You know where Big Eye is?
That's where the last place, I played there, too, once or twice, at the San Suu Tidgin Hall upstairs. And I gave a dance there myself and played my own dance with René.
